title: Secret Sauce simulation name pools
description: simData/people.json — the given/family name pools and bio templates supabase/sim/2_sim_generate.sql draws every simulated profile from. Not read at runtime and not read by Postgres: tool/sim.dart validates this file and generates supabase/sim/1_sim_people.sql from it, and `melos run sim:check` fails when that .sql is stale. No JSON Schema library is in the toolchain, so every rule stated here is ALSO implemented in tool/sim.dart — change both. Design note: the locale mix is deliberately EVEN, because this pool exists to exercise rendering (diacritics, Cyrillic, right-to-left Arabic, single-word names) rather than to model a real user base.

note.description: Free prose for whoever opens the file. Ignored by the generator.

locales.description: One entry per naming tradition. Given and family names are drawn from the SAME locale for one actor, so a generated name reads as a coherent name rather than a two-culture collage. Array order is not significant — the locale itself is drawn uniformly.

code.description: Stable identifier and the primary key of sim.locale. Unique across the file.

label.description: Human-readable name of the tradition, shown only in sim notices.

cuisine.description: Substituted into any bio containing the literal `{cuisine}`, so a bio and the name above it agree.

bios.description: Profile bio templates. `{cuisine}` is the ONLY placeholder the generator substitutes; any other `{...}` is a validation error, because an unsubstituted placeholder ships to the profile screen as literal braces.
